listing.name: Banjo-Kazooie / Lighthouse [Android Port] (izzy2lost)
listing.summary: Explore Banjo-Kazooie / Lighthouse [Android Port] (izzy2lost) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Finish setup in the upstream Android app
steps.instruction: Install this fork’s Android APK and open it to generate the Banjo-Kazooie O2R on the device. No PC or separate extraction app is needed. Supply your own supported .z64 ROM; the selected guide lists US 1.0, US 1.1, Japanese and PAL versions. US 1.0 is the recommended base if you need the fork’s ROM-hack support. Follow the app’s own import and Play flow.

steps.title: Keep your data when changing versions
steps.instruction: Keep your original ROM and back up the Android app’s actual saves, configuration, generated O2R and mods before changing or removing it. The selected release confirms on-device generation and mod/ROM-hack support, but does not establish an Android save/export path. Parent desktop paths are not an Android storage contract. Updates remain upstream-owned.
